comments.text: It’s worth pointing out that it was dangerous for him to highlight the bad parts of China while he was still living there. In one of his videos he mentioned that during his time in China he had recorded a lot of footage but he was understandably afraid to publish it (I believe he partly addresses it in this video unless my memory is failing me: [VIDEO] ). I personally like this video a lot: [LINK] . It talks a bit about why the rest of the world had no masks or other medical equipment when the Wuhan Virus spread outside of China. There’s also another foreigner who was semi-famous in China that’s now making funny videos about China (e.g. [LINK] ).
